page_title: SEV 1-2 BAR | Sevilla v Barcelona 26/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.

90+5' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) produces a shot from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His effort sails narrowly over the crossbar. The goalkeeper was lucky there. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
90+5' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Sevilla have a free kick.

90+4' Alejo Veliz (Sevilla) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva who sees an offensive foul. Barcelona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
90+3' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
90+3' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) has too much to say to the referee and receives a caution.
90+3' Rough tackle by Oriol Romeu (Barcelona). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Sevilla.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The substitution has been made. Alejo Veliz (Sevilla) has replaced Youssef En Nesyri.

89' The ball rebounds off the defender into the path of Jules Kounde (Barcelona), who immediately strikes for goal from inside the box but sends it a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
89' Hector Fort (Barcelona) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
86' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
85' Mariano Diaz (Sevilla) sends a chip pass into the box, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen is quickest to intercept the ball.
84' Pedri (Barcelona) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Orjan Nyland comes off the line to clear the ball away.
84' Xavi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hector Fort (Barcelona) replacing Joao Cancelo.
83' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sevilla comes to nothing.
83' Sevilla take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

82' Mariano Diaz (Sevilla) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen reacts superbly to deny him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Sevilla.
79' Here's the change. Loic Bade leaves the pitch and Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) comes on as a substitute.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lucien Agoume departs the field of play to be replaced by Manuel Bueno Sebastian (Sevilla).
79' Quique Sanchez Flores decides to make a substitution. Dodi Lukebakio will be replaced by Mariano Diaz (Sevilla).
77' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
75' Substitution. Vitor Roque (Barcelona) has come on for Fermin Lopez.
74' Sevilla can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
74' A snap shot by Marcao (Sevilla) from the edge of the area flies towards the top right corner, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen produces a good reflex save to thwart him. Sevilla have a corner.
71' Good movement by Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
71' Barcelona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

70' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Barcelona will take a corner kick.
69' Marcao (Sevilla) makes a slide tackle, but referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows for a foul. Barcelona will take a free kick.
65' Joao Felix (Barcelona) gets inside the penalty area and sends a powerful shot that almost ends inside the net. The keeper is alert and makes a good save.
64' The attendance for today's match is 34888.
62' Xavi prepares a substitution. Lamine Yamal is replaced by Joao Felix (Barcelona).
62' A substitution has been made. Robert Lewandowski is replaced by Ferran Torres (Barcelona).
62' Javier Iglesias Villanueva has a clear sight and sees a foul from Fermin Lopez (Barcelona). Sevilla have been awarded a free kick.
59' 1 - 2 Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom left corner in trademark fashion.
59' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marc-Andre ter Stegen, who smothers the ball.
58' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Boubakary Soumare (Sevilla).
58' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows for a foul. Sevilla are awarded the free kick.

55' Lucas Ocampos (Sevilla) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
55' A player from Barcelona commits a rough challenge. Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. It's a free kick to Sevilla in a dangerous position.
54' Flag goes up against Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

53' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Orjan Nyland anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.

53' Sergio Ramos (Sevilla) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Barcelona, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
51' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
49' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Javier Iglesias Villanueva ignores the protests.
46' Quique Sanchez Flores makes a switch. Marcao (Sevilla) is coming on in place of Kike Salas at the start of the second period.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Xavi probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Andreas Christensen (Barcelona). He is replaced by Oriol Romeu.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+3' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Orjan Nyland intercepts the ball.
45+3' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

45+1' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Marc-Andre ter Stegen is alert and denies him with a nice save. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.

45' Javier Iglesias Villanueva interrupts the game. One of the players from Sevilla won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. It's a free kick to Barcelona, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
45' Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the left post.
44' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
44' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
42' Barcelona are ruled offside.
41' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
39' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
37' OFF THE BAR! Pedri (Barcelona) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and fires a bullet of a shot that crashes against the crossbar.
36' Today's referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva rightly decides to book Kike Salas (Sevilla) for his harsh tackle.
36' The resulting set piece from Barcelona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

35' Orjan Nyland makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Pedri (Barcelona) after a cross from the side. Barcelona force their opponents to concede a corner.
34' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
32' A cooling break is underway.
31' 1 - 1 Youssef En Nesyri (Sevilla) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and scores! He buries the ball into the bottom left corner.
30' Half-chance! Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) plays a pass into the box, but Orjan Nyland reacts well to snuff out the attack.
28' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
27' A cross from a corner kick by Sevilla is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
25' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
25' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sevilla.

24' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Marc-Andre ter Stegen is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him. Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
24' The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
22' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
20' Pedri (Barcelona) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
17' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

15' 0 - 1 Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) meets a perfect cross from Joao Cancelo deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner via the post. It's 0:1.
14' Barcelona fail to threaten from the corner kick as the opposition's goalkeeper plucks the ball out of the air.
14' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) serves up a nice cross, but Orjan Nyland punches the ball away.
11' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
10' Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
8' The game is interrupted as Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) is flagged offside.
6' Pedri (Barcelona) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva saw the whole situation. A free kick to Sevilla.
4' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
3' One of the Sevilla players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle. Barcelona have a free kick.
2' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
1' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Sevilla win a free kick.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Sevilla will have the kick-off.
Javier Iglesias Villanueva got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
